source_gap_claims.behavior: Network-capability declarations specify allowed schemes and targets, and identify the owner for redirects, DNS resolution, private/loopback/metadata blocking, controlled internal exceptions, and timeouts. Reject arbitrary URL execution, HTTP downgrade, or missing redirect/address policy; Package A performs no DNS lookup, URL request, or network-tool installation.
source_gap_claims.reason: No supplied obligation requires these network-specific declarations, rejection cases, or Package A execution boundary.
source_gap_claims.subject: Network capability declarations and validation

source_gap_claims.behavior: Explicit inventory mode reports a pre-standard fixture as legacy, while strict mode rejects it. A migrated fixture validates while retaining its owner-specific authority and lifecycle fields, verified by a before/after comparison; an absent quality sidecar cannot pass silently, and validation never rewrites the inspected package.
source_gap_claims.reason: No supplied obligation covers inventory-versus-strict behavior, migration preservation of owner fields, or non-mutating validation.
source_gap_claims.subject: Legacy inventory and migration compatibility

source_gap_claims.behavior: Validate the actual published policy and both schemas against a small Package A reference package under the fixture tree through the published CLI. Terminal acceptance fails for inconsistent policy/schema versions, unused policy, schema-invalid results, dangling standard links, or an invalid reference package.
source_gap_claims.reason: No supplied obligation requires end-to-end validation of the published policy, schemas, reference fixture, and CLI or these terminal acceptance failure conditions.
source_gap_claims.subject: Published standard artifacts and reference package

source_gap_claims.behavior: A single repository-owned pytest terminal selection executes all Package A unit, boundary, negative, and CLI integration cases with independent expected results and explicit case/assertion mappings. Required cases cannot be missing, skipped, deselected, xfailed, zero-case, or lost to harness errors; an expected rejection of a negative fixture counts as a passing test.
source_gap_claims.reason: No supplied obligation specifies complete terminal test selection, case-to-assertion mapping, or these safeguards against incomplete or invalid test runs.
source_gap_claims.subject: Package A terminal test selection and execution
